serve:app-with-own-auth.description: Runs the Hono app-with-own-auth example in development mode.

serve:app-with-external-auth.description: Runs the Hono app-with-external-auth example in development mode.

serve:api-service.description: Runs the Hono api-service example in development mode.

dev:app-with-own-auth.description: Runs the Hono app-with-own-auth example with auto-reload.

dev:app-with-external-auth.description: Runs the Hono app-with-external-auth example with auto-reload.

dev:api-service.description: Runs the Hono api-service example with auto-reload.

test.description: Runs the OAuth2 package tests only. Use `test:all` before pushing — the examples and templates have their own suites.

test:scripts.description: Runs the tests for the repository scripts.

test:all.description: Runs every test suite in the repository: the package, the scripts, the examples, and the starter templates.
test:all.command: deno task test && deno task test:scripts && deno task test:examples && deno task test:templates

test:app-with-own-auth.description: Runs the Hono app-with-own-auth example tests.

test:app-with-external-auth.description: Runs the Hono app-with-external-auth example tests.

test:api-service.description: Runs the Hono api-service example tests.

serve:juniper-own-auth.description: Runs the Juniper app-with-own-auth example in development mode.

dev:juniper-own-auth.description: Runs the Juniper app-with-own-auth example with auto-reload.

test:juniper-own-auth.description: Runs the Juniper app-with-own-auth example tests.

serve:juniper-external-auth.description: Runs the Juniper app-with-external-auth example in development mode.

dev:juniper-external-auth.description: Runs the Juniper app-with-external-auth example with auto-reload.

test:juniper-external-auth.description: Runs the Juniper app-with-external-auth example tests.

serve:template-juniper.description: Runs the Juniper starter template in development mode.

test:template-juniper.description: Runs the Juniper starter template tests.

serve:template-react-router.description: Runs the React Router starter template in development mode.

test:template-react-router.description: Runs the React Router starter template tests.

test:examples.command: deno task test:app-with-own-auth && deno task test:app-with-external-auth && deno task test:api-service && deno task test:juniper-own-auth && deno task test:juniper-external-auth

test:templates.description: Runs every starter template's test suite.
test:templates.command: deno task test:template-juniper && deno task test:template-react-router

check.description: Checks the code for errors, formatting, and runs the linter.
check.command: deno check && deno lint && deno fmt --check && deno task doc-lint && deno task doc-check && deno task doc-links && deno task llms:check && deno task check:publish && deno task check:packaging

doc-links.description: Fails when a shipped doc links the private monorepo or a monorepo-relative command.

check:publish.description: Fails when the package would not publish to JSR, before a release tag makes the version immutable.
check:publish.command: deno task publish:prepare && cd src && deno publish --dry-run --allow-dirty

check:packaging.description: Type-checks the published entrypoints from outside the workspace, under a foreign import map and compilerOptions, and asserts the release-packaging invariants.
check:packaging.command: deno task --cwd=smoke-consumer check && deno task --cwd=smoke-consumer test

npm:build.description: Builds the npm artifact from src/ into npm/ with dnt. Optional argument overrides the version (used by the release pipeline).

npm:smoke.description: Packs the built npm artifact and proves it from Node: installs the tarball into npm-smoke-consumer/, type-checks with tsc, and imports every Node-supported subpath at runtime. Run npm:build first.

llms:generate.description: Regenerates llms-full.txt from the pages llms.txt indexes.

llms:check.description: Fails when a docs page is unindexed, a link is dead, or llms-full.txt is stale.

doc-lint.description: Fails when any public export is missing contract-level JSDoc.

doc-check.description: Type-checks every `ts`/`tsx` snippet in the README and docs, and every JSDoc `@example` in the API reference.

psl:update.description: Regenerates the bundled Public Suffix List from publicsuffix.org.

psl:check.description: Fails when the bundled Public Suffix List has drifted from publicsuffix.org.

publish:prepare.description: Stages consumer documentation in src/ for a complete JSR payload.

release:prepare.description: Stages the release version and documentation without publishing.
